completed_units: Consumed the durable finite discrete-adjoint checkpoint and preserved its exact no-new-constraint conclusion: repeated differentiation/SBP of the same evaluation adjoint closes back to F_2(1/2)=S_m-2 and cannot determine the independent LIFT digit.
Recovered and independently checked the source valuation-band decomposition G=G_T+pY mod p^2 and h=H_U+pA mod p^2, yielding Delta_p=Z_T+Gbar A+hbar Y mod p with Z_T=(G_T H_U-1)/p.
Proved the recovered absolute unit-core reduction is an exact all-target strict reduction: LIFT is equivalent to Z_T=R_p-Gbar A-hbar Y mod p, with middle and high valuation provenance retained.
Constructed the exact finite-Gauss cutoff parameter-jet bridge at a=p/6 and derived Z_T=[a_parent Psi-1]/p+a_parent H_1^{<=m}/6+Psi F_2^{<=2m}/72 mod p, with exact middle/high support recombination.
Proved a uniform rational first-order adjoint obstruction for the three-layer cutoff transport and identified the exact hypergeometric partial-period residual.

Proved the requested zero-edge gluing: the two sectorwise q2 period quotients are removable-edge charts of one finite-tail quotient Z_k(a)=sum_{j=k}^{2m}T_j(a)/T_k(a), whose base 0/1/2 jet is exactly F_0,F_1,F_2^{<=2m}.

Proved the normalized 2-jet of that finite-tail quotient supplies an exact non-rational first-order adjoint for the constant q2 weight, while the analogous weighted low-tail one-jet supplies the q1 cutoff adjoint; both close onto already-owned cutoff coordinates and introduce no independent period coordinate.

Proved the minimal first-order period extension is lossless but non-reductive: it exactly reconstructs a_parent H_1^{<=m}/6 + Psi F_2^{<=2m}/72, gives no equation for [a_parent Psi-1]/p or R_p, and therefore cannot close JT2/LIFT. Symbolic and exact small-m checks verify the adjoint identities and removable zero-edge charts; these checks are regression only.

Proved a supersingular Frobenius-route information no-go: the full ASD/Katz characteristic-polynomial recurrence is invariant under c(p-1)->c(p-1)+p^2 t, so it cannot determine the next normalized p-1 coefficient digit. Independently derived the exact product-second-digit carrier FROB2=U^2-(e_a+e_b), showing that at least one new F_p lifted coefficient-comparison scalar is necessary; exact regression over all 166 target primes p<5000 had zero failures.

Proved an exact Proposition-16 divided-power quotient information boundary for the D25 product observer: A->A+p W^{-1}t changes the primitive by p W^{-1}t xi^p, which is zero in the published quotient modulo p A[[xi]], while shifting the product second digit. Therefore that quotient cannot determine D25. Strictly reduced the minimal new Frobenius input to one direct product scalar K_p=(a(p-1)b(p-1)+p)/p^2=U^2-E_p mod p.

Derived the exact d=3, lambda=1/2 quartic-twist second-digit split from the source local-parameter scaling: Delta_3=(1-lambda)^{-1}=2, so for every target prime D_p=2^((p-1)/2)=-1+p tau_p mod p^2 with tau_p=(2^((p-1)/2)+1)/p mod p. If the durable normalized product is C_p=-p+p^2 K_p mod p^3, then exact untwisting gives C_p D_p^{-1}=p+p^2(tau_p-K_p) mod p^3. Thus the twist contribution is an explicit half-Fermat digit, and the remaining bridge is strictly reduced to the raw d=3 coefficient/companion product plus finite Clausen/truncation/endpoint correction. Deterministic regression checked 664 instances over all 166 target primes below 5000 with zero failures; regression is not proof.
current_unfinished_unit: D25 LIFT/JT2 remains open. The quartic twist no longer belongs to the unknown second-digit residue: its exact contribution is tau_p. The unresolved source information is now the actual K_p / untwisted product digit from H_{3,p-1}(t) and the normalized companion differential, followed by a one-order-deeper bridge from that raw product to the finite-Gauss divided product digit and endpoint correction.

Do not search again for a pure uniform rational first-order adjoint; the q2 equation is proved rationally insoluble.
Do not treat the hypergeometric period as a new independent free coordinate: its exact finite-tail jet gluing is now proved, but do not call it rational.
Do not rerun the first-order period-extended adjoint expecting a new LIFT constraint; it is proved to close tautologically onto the existing cutoff derivative terms.
Do not discard or absorb [a_parent Psi-1]/p, Psi, F_0,F_1,F_2^{<=2m}, H_1^{<=m}, A, Y, the m/2m edges, or the labelled terminal -2 source before a proved identity pays them.
Do not reopen accepted D24 UR/JT0, CM0/SIMPLE, earlier shell/Clausen/Green reductions, or enlarge finite-prime scans as a substitute for proof.

Do not try to recover the lifted p-1 coefficient digit by merely increasing r in the supersingular ASD/Katz characteristic-polynomial recurrence; the p^2 gauge perturbation is proved invisible to the whole recurrence family.
Do not attempt to recover K_p from the Proposition-16 divided-power quotient modulo p A[[xi]] alone; the gauge A->A+p W^{-1}t is proved invisible there while changing K_p.

Do not split the product-observer carrier E_p into separate e_a and e_b unless a later observer proves it needs their individual provenance; K_p is lossless for the current product second-digit observer.
Do not replace the target quartic factor 2^((p-1)/2) by only its Legendre sign -1 at D25 precision; the erased first lift is tau_p.
Do not assert that the untwisted de Rham coefficient product equals the weighted finite-Gauss sum W_p modulo p^3 without a proved one-order-deeper finite Clausen/truncation and endpoint audit.
